firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-brand-.description: Collect a named organization's existing logo, colors, fonts, and homepage messaging for a deck or document. Use for website-derived assets; report sourced links and observed styling.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-busine.description: Find published organizational emails, phone numbers, and official contact forms for named businesses or local services. Use for sourced business contacts; exclude employee direct details.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-design.description: Extract a reference website's design system into DESIGN.md with tokens, layout, components, and imagery. Use for recreating its visual style or documenting UI patterns.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-enrich.description: Enrich one professional or a supplied list/CSV with role, employer, profile, history, and requested business fields. Use for a named person, professional profile, or existing leads; not prospecting.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-fantas.description: Research fantasy start/sit, waiver, trade, draft, or keeper decisions using current player news, usage, matchups, and league scoring. Use for roster decisions; do not change rosters or place bets.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-find-l.description: Find professionals matching role, company, location, or expertise criteria. Use for prospect lists or expert and speaker discovery; return evidence of fit and professional profile links.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-firecr.description: Search web sources, read supplied pages, and retrieve structured data with Firecrawl. Use when a request needs current external evidence or source discovery.
Investigate questions needing multi-source synthesis: deep dives, comparisons, or find-all lists. Prefer focused workflows for enrichment, prospecting, or docs; not quick lookups or shopping.
Investigate library/API implementation, bugs, and version discrepancies using public repository code, issues, and pull requests. Use when official documentation alone is insufficient.
Find scientific papers, follow citations, and verify claims against paper passages. Use for literature questions, related work, citing papers, references, or questions about a named paper.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-job-po.description: Find current job postings by role, employer, location, or remote eligibility. Use for who's hiring, job shortlists, and openings matching supplied skills, experience, or pay preferences.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-read-d.description: Read official library, SDK, and API docs for setup, code examples, migrations, compatibility, or library-specific errors when supplied code or documentation does not answer the question.

firecrawl-firecrawl-claude-plugin-seo-au.description: Inspect named pages for SEO metadata, headings, canonicals, schema, and link issues. Use for source-backed SEO audits and prioritized fixes; distinguish unverified checks from observed defects.
